info.title: UniFi Public API
info.description: Production API operations organized around the UniFi payment lifecycle. Internal administration, worker, dashboard, support, scheduling, and Falcon orchestration routes are intentionally excluded.

get.description: Lightweight liveness check. It does not test the database, blockchain RPCs, or every downstream dependency.
Runs the deeper service health check, including production dependencies. This operation consumes protected API capacity.

200.description: The API and required dependencies are healthy.

get.summary: Get a wallet address for a chain
get.description: Resolves the user's wallet address for the requested chain.
Returns the user's wallet address for every supported chain protocol.
Returns the formatted net balance for one user, chain, and stablecoin.

get.summary: Get all stablecoin balances on a chain
get.description: Returns formatted balances for every supported stablecoin on the requested chain.

get.summary: Get the complete wallet balance view
get.description: Returns all supported assets across all supported chains, ordered by total USD value.
Returns each supported stablecoin balance and USD value for one chain.
Returns the selected stablecoin's balance and USD value across supported chains.
Returns the user's formatted net balance before creating a payment.
Returns the formatted estimated total stablecoin fee for the selected route.

200.description: Estimated fee denominated in the selected stablecoin.

get.description: Combines spendable balance, estimated fee, and allowance state for the selected route.

post.description: Checks the sender balance and Permit2 allowance, then estimates the payment fee for one self-custodial payment.

200.description: The balance, allowance, and estimated fee required for the payment.

post.description: Checks balances and Permit2 allowances by coin, then estimates the total fee for a self-custodial bulk payment.

200.description: Balances and allowances by coin, plus the total estimated fee.

get.description: Returns raw allowance, balance, gas, and price inputs for client-side self-custodial payment calculations.

200.description: The raw inputs used to calculate balance and fee requirements.

post.description: Submits a payment from a UniFi-managed wallet. The response is a receipt ID; query the receipt endpoint for settlement progress.
Submits a merchant payment from a UniFi-managed wallet and associates its receipt with the supplied payment session.
Builds the EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message that the sender signs before submitting one self-custodial payment.

200.description: The EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message to sign.

post.description: Builds the EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message that the sender signs before submitting a self-custodial bulk payment.

200.description: The EIP-712 domain and Permit2 message to sign.

post.description: Submits one payment with the sender's Permit2 nonce and signature. The response is a receipt ID; query the receipt endpoint for settlement progress.
Submits a signed Permit2 batch and returns the receipt IDs created for its individual payments.

200.description: The receipt IDs created for the batch.

post.description: Submits a signed self-custodial merchant payment and associates its receipt with the supplied payment session.

get.summary: Get a merchant payment session status
get.description: Returns the receipt ID associated with a merchant payment session. An empty data string means that no receipt has been attached yet.

200.description: The associated receipt ID, or an empty string while the session is waiting for payment.

get.description: Returns the latest known state of one stablecoin payment.

Returns a page of receipts. For a continuation request, set next_or_previous and pass the receipt ID at the current page edge as cursor: the last receipt for the next page or the first receipt for the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of receipts to return.

parameters.name: next_or_previous
parameters.description: true requests the next page; false requests the previous page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Receipt ID at the current page edge. Required for stateless continuation requests; use the last receipt ID for next and the first receipt ID for previous.

bearerAuth.description: Use a UniFi API key generated from the web app and stored server-side.
